### Consolidated readback transcript — UTM 4.7.5 / macOS 26.6.2 / 2026-09-08T17:24:46Z

# PROVENANCE. Every section below is captured verbatim by readback-transcript.sh: the
# driver echoes each command, runs it with stdout and stderr merged, and prints its exit
# code. Nothing here is hand-written. The committed driver is the same script with two
# paths parameterised (AS defaults to ./applescript, OUT to $TMPDIR); the run recorded
# here used absolute scratchpad paths, which is why they appear in full below.
#
# Because this driver merges the streams, it cannot show WHICH stream a line arrived on
# or the un-piped exit status. Two behaviours that turn on exactly that are captured in
# their own fixtures instead, each with its own driver or provenance note:
#   attach-and-default-drives.txt  -- `utmctl attach` / `utmctl start --attach`, and the
#                                     drives UTM invents when `make` omits the key
#   orphan-qemu-process.txt        -- trap T12, a one-off observation
# Section numbering therefore runs 0..13 then 14 (cleanup); there is no 15.

## 4. T5 quirk: 'count of' is always 0; 'length of' works except for serial ports
$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set c to configuration of (virtual machine named "wargame-t1-evidence")
	set d to 0
	repeat with x in (drives of c)
		set d to d + 1
	end repeat
	set sp to 0
	repeat with x in (serial ports of c)
		set sp to sp + 1
	end repeat
	return "drives: loop=" & (d as text) & " count-of=" & ((count of drives of c) as text) & " length-of=" & ((length of (drives of c)) as text) & "  ||  serial ports: loop=" & (sp as text) & " count-of=" & ((count of serial ports of c) as text) & " length-of=" & ((length of (serial ports of c)) as text)
end tell'
drives: loop=3 count-of=0 length-of=3  ||  serial ports: loop=0 count-of=0 length-of=0
exit=0

## 5. qemu additional arguments round-trip (T10)
$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set vm to virtual machine named "wargame-t1-evidence"
	set c to configuration of vm
	set qemu additional arguments of c to {{argument string:"-device"}, {argument string:"virtio-balloon-pci"}}
	update configuration of vm with c
	set c2 to configuration of vm
	set out to ""
	repeat with a in (qemu additional arguments of c2)
		set out to out & (argument string of a) & " "
	end repeat
	return "readback: " & out
end tell'
readback: -device virtio-balloon-pci 
exit=0

$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set vm to virtual machine named "wargame-t1-evidence"
	set c to configuration of vm
	set qemu additional arguments of c to {}
	update configuration of vm with c
	set c2 to configuration of vm
	return "cleared, length=" & ((length of (qemu additional arguments of c2)) as text)
end tell'
cleared, length=0
exit=0

# delete the imported duplicate again, by UUID
$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set out to ""

## 12. x86_64: hypervisor:false vs hypervisor:true, config readback AND generated accel
$ osascript /Users/moreal/github/moreal/dreamhack-sandbox/crates/wargame-utm/tests/fixtures/applescript/create-qemu-vm.applescript wargame-t1-evidence-x86 x86_64 false '/Users/moreal/Library/Application Support/wargame-vm/iso/kali-linux-2026.2-installer-amd64.iso'
BB6CAE03-810D-4A33-93BB-E632BA9446A2	wargame-t1-evidence-x86	arch=x86_64	machine=q35	hypervisor=false	uefi=true	netmode=shared
exit=0

$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"

$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set vm to virtual machine named "wargame-t1-evidence-x86"
	set c to configuration of vm
	set hypervisor of c to true
	update configuration of vm with c
	return "update issued"
end tell'
update issued
exit=0

$ osascript -e 'tell application "UTM"
	set c to configuration of (virtual machine named "wargame-t1-evidence-x86")
	return "config readback hypervisor=" & ((hypervisor of c) as text)

config readback hypervisor=true
exit=0

$ utmctl start wargame-t1-evidence-x86
exit=0

$ sleep 8; true
exit=0
